entities.summary: Sarghis Baghdasaryan, also Baghdasarian, was a Soviet Armenian sculptor. He is best known for his 1967 work – We Are Our Mountains, a monument carved into the tuff outside Stepanakert. Locally, it is known as Mamik yev Babik.
